name: Resistor Environment QA 24
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Potential at a junction with multiple resistors

examples.input: At a junction connecting resistors R1 = \SI{10}{\ohm}, R2 = \SI{5}{\ohm}, R3 = \SI{2}{\ohm} and potentials V1 = \SI{20}{\volt}, V2 = \SI{10}{\volt}, V3 = \SI{-10}{\volt} applied respectively at non-junction ends, what is the potential at the junction approximately?
